description: S46 T8 (MG5/MG8): mcp.mine.status answers reachability of the agent's own servers from the SHARED probe CACHE only — nothing spawned, no process, no connection (a spy in cmd/aeon pins it). A server never probed answers the distinct word "unchecked": its own honest state, never an assumed-up or assumed-down (P31's three states at the agent door).
